image_description: Two distinct clusters of pale yellow/cream-colored coral fungi growing on a dark, mossy log. The fungi exhibit complex, upright branching structures resembling marine coral, with multiple cylindrical branches arising from common bases and dividing into finer tips. The background is dark and out of focus, highlighting the fungi against the textured bark surface.
